result.instructions: Tools for inFlow Inventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are below their reorder level at the main warehouse?"; "Show me the stock on hand for SKU-1042 across all locations."; "List the sales orders still waiting to ship and their customers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes inFlow Inventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inflow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. inflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inflow_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (SKUs) in the inFlow company, with name, SKU, category, unit of measure and tracking flags. Use this first to find productId values. GET /{companyId}/products.

after.description: Pagination: return entries sorted after this id. Pass the id of the last entry from the previous page.

sort.description: inFlow property name to sort by, for example name.

sortDesc.description: true to sort in descending order.

name.description: Only return entries whose name matches this filter (sent as filter[name]).

tools.name: inflow_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by productId, including its costs, prices and tracking settings. GET /{companyId}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: inflow_get_product_summary
tools.title: Get product stock summary
tools.description: Get stock levels for one product: quantity on hand, on order, reserved and on transfer. Optionally limit to one location. GET /{companyId}/products/{productId}/summary.

locationId.description: Limit the summary to this location GUID (from inflow_list_locations).

tools.name: inflow_upsert_product
tools.title: Create or update a product
tools.description: Create a product (omit productId: a new GUID is generated) or update one (pass productId). Omitted fields keep their value on update. Set timestamp from a read to block overwriting a newer edit. PUT /{companyId}/products.

productId.description: Existing product GUID to update. Omit to create a new product.

trackLots.description: Track this product by lot number.

trackSerials.description: Track this product by serial number.

timestamp.description: Last-known timestamp from a read. Omit to skip the concurrency check.

tools.name: inflow_create_stock_adjustment
tools.title: Create a stock adjustment
tools.description: Change stock levels: add or remove quantity per product at one location, with a reason. Each line quantity is in the product's standard unit. Changes inventory at once. PUT /{companyId}/stock-adjustments.

locationId.description: Location GUID where the stock changes (from inflow_list_locations).

allowNegativeInventory.description: true to allow stock to go below zero. Default false: inFlow returns an error instead.

quantity.description: Quantity to add (positive) or remove (negative), in the product's standard unit.

uom.description: Unit name to show, for example each. Must be the product's standard unit, because no conversion is applied.
